title: Remove Internet Identity UX flow; remove admin special-password field from signup

requirements.summary: Ensure the active UX/auth flow is local-session only and remove non-immutable Internet Identity dependencies from reachable frontend code paths.
acceptanceCriteria: A new user can sign in using the existing local session sign-in flow (Ed25519 local identity) and can reach the app without any Internet Identity UI.
No routes or screens require Internet Identity to proceed (local-session auth is sufficient).
No frontend components/routes import or depend on the Internet Identity hooks for user sign-in/sign-out in the active flow (outside immutable platform files).

file_operations.description: Make App rely on the immutable root providers (frontend/src/main.tsx) for React Query, and keep LocalSessionAuthProvider as the only app-level auth provider used by reachable routes; ensure the app boot sequence does not trigger any Internet Identity login UI/redirects (continue calling ensureNoInternetIdentityAutoAuth on mount).

Confirm AuthGate exclusively uses useLocalSessionAuth for sign-in and gating, and that all unauthenticated states present only the local-session sign-in UI (no Internet Identity messaging, prompts, or calls).

Ensure header sign-in/sign-out actions exclusively use useLocalSessionAuth + useFullLogout and do not import/use Internet Identity hooks; keep wording and actions aligned with local-session authentication.

Harden local-session actor initialization so it never falls back to Internet Identity-based actor creation logic; keep identity-based actor creation tied strictly to the local Ed25519 identity and ensure anonymous mode remains supported.

Audit and adjust all query/mutation hooks to ensure they only depend on useLocalActor/useLocalSessionAuth and do not reference useActor/useInternetIdentity; keep query keys scoped by local principalId to prevent cross-session data leakage.
Keep the best-effort Internet Identity persistence cleanup, and ensure it is safe/idempotent so the app never re-enters an Internet Identity flow due to residual AuthClient state.

requirements.summary: Remove the admin special-password step from the signup UI so admin-eligible users are not blocked by an extra password field.
acceptanceCriteria: In the signup UI, selecting "Admin" does not require entering an additional admin signup password field.
Backend admin signup for admin-eligible users does not fail due to a missing/incorrect special password requirement.
A user who signs up as an admin-eligible username can access the admin area ("/admin/users") once their admin role is established by the backend access control flow.

file_operations.description: Remove the admin signup password input, validation, and related helper text; when "Admin" is selected, submit via the non-password signup path (signupWithRole) using the admin role selection. Use existing shadcn/ui form components (Button/Input/Label/Card/Alert/RadioGroup). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update signup hooks usage to support admin selection without an extra password parameter (prefer signupWithRole for both engineer/admin as per UI change); keep cache invalidation behavior consistent after signup.
